text:
jordan: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp duplicated DB rows after a 429. Repro steps: call /generate, control-plane returns 429, SDK retries and we get duplicate side-effect.

priya: ugh. which SDK + config?

jordan: Node SDK v1.4.2. We didn’t set safeReplayWindow in sampleapp; Console shows "Retry window: 5" (no unit). SDK default safeReplayWindow=5000 (ms). Console export has retry_window=5 and control-plane omitted units. SDK ended up treating the 5 as ms in internal logic, so replay allowed for only 5ms in some codepaths and elsewhere treated as 5s — inconsistent.

eli: that mismatch would definitely explain a retry slipping through. is this a schema/compat issue?

marta: deploy-bot rollout-schema-v2 added optional "replayWindowUnits"; legacy configs simply store numeric value with no units. ci-bot flagged missing field on an old migration PR.

priya: exact payload from control-plane when exporting the route: ```{ "route": "/generate", "retry_window": 5 }```

jordan: sampleapp log excerpt:
```
[2026-03-18T14:22:01Z] requestId=abc123 status=429
[2026-03-18T14:22:01Z] replay_guard: window_ms=5 allow_replay=true -> performing retry
[2026-03-18T14:22:02Z] duplicate_write detected, db.insert idempotency_key missing
```

eli: OK clear signal. UX should show units, control-plane should include units, SDKs should be defensive.

marta: proposed fixes:
- Console: show unit suffix + validation on save (eg "5 s" or "5000 ms") and tooltips about legacy ambiguity
- Control plane: include explicit field "retry_window_units" in API responses and backfill migration script to set reasonable defaults
- SDKs: accept both legacy numeric and new {value, units} shapes; warn when legacy numeric used; apply heuristic fallback
- Sampleapp: add e2e that simulates 429 and asserts no duplicate side effects when idempotency-key present

priya: heuristic idea for SDKs: if numeric < 1000 treat as ms, else treat as seconds, and emit a warning. Better than silently assuming ms everywhere.

jordan: +1 but we should also surface a migration banner in Console for routes missing units so customers notice. We should treat this as high-risk for onboarding flows.

eli: filing INF-5923 to unify retry-window-units. Plan: quick SDK patch (Node + Py) with heuristic + warning; Console UI validation + banner; control-plane API addition and migration.

marta: I’ll take Console UX + banner and a tiny modal to let customers pick units for ambiguous routes. ETA: 48h for UI patch branch. I’ll also add a server-side sanity check that prevents saving windows < 50ms.

priya: I’ll open the sampleapp PR w/ e2e harness (in-memory DB, idempotency-key check) within 24–36h. ci-bot: add the e2e to CI.

jordan: owners checklist:
- SDK heuristic + warning (eli) :assigned
- Console validation + banner (marta) :assigned
- Control-plane API field + migration (infra) :mentioned
- sampleapp e2e (priya) :assigned
- Docs + release notes (jordan) :assigned

eli: also recommend server-side clamp: if incoming legacy numeric seems ambiguous, record audit event and clamp to minimum safe value.

marta: agreed. I’ll add server-side clamp and migration audit.

priya: cool. i’ll paste PR links here when ready. :thumbsup: 

jordan: thanks — i’ll monitor onboarding telemetry and open an alert if duplicates increase.

deploy-bot: deployment queued for console/ui patch (#3157) by marta

ci-bot: e2e tests added to sampleapp PR 1289 (pending review)
